text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I had come to check out an event
co-sponsored by the academy and Bubbly Land,
when...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Nakayama-senpai?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El would really like to know what on earth
you brought me all the way here for~...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El.
Do you know what's happening here today?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, the "Horse Girl Water Gun Tournament"?
Don't tell me we're participating in that, desuよね...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That exact "tell me".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A while back, you said
you wanted to do a tandem run with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then win this tournament.
If you do, I'll take you on.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿¡Qué?! What does that have to do withーー

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not asking about that.
Are you in, or are you out? Which is it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
On one condition! When I win,
you definitely have to run with me this time desu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, a deal's a deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, El Condor Pasa entered the
"Horse Girl Water Gun Tournament"—

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! Competitor El Condor Pasa
takes down 3 opponents in a rooowww!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Toryaaa!! There is no escape from
El's aerial acrobatics, no deee-su!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Think so? Let's see about that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...El will not lose!
Because I'm going to win and have you run with me, desu!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's the look...! Come at me, El!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I did it!
It's El's grand victory, deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That was some pretty quick draw... You got me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man, and here I thought I was pretty decent with a water gun.
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good grief, why don't ya put that kind of passion into your training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Close one, but you're not quite at my level yet.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I was so close, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I pride myself on my shooting skills, ya know.
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good grief, why don't ya put that kind of passion into your training, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: During that match race, you didn't have that "I gotta beat the person in front of me no matter what" fire, did ya?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Because I'm serious, I run with fast runners! I rethink my training! I do so much every single day, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All so I can hold my own overseas!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was it... really like that...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was so worried about whether I'd make it overseas...
that instead of focusing on winning, I only cared about reassuring myself...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow after school.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ? What about tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A match race training session.
What, ya not up for it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-Of course I want to, desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This time I'm going in with full intent to win, so brace yourself, deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Finally... looks like we'll get a real nail-biter of a showdown!!
